topPriorities.name: Fragrance Quiz / AI Scent Recommender
topPriorities.why: Zero competitors have a recommendation engine. Incense has 50+ variants — customers abandon without guidance. Quiz → personalized match = higher conversion, lower returns.
topPriorities.implementation: 5-question quiz: 1) Occasion (meditation/pooja/relaxation/gifting), 2) Scent preference (floral/woody/fresh/spicy), 3) Intensity (mild/medium/intense), 4) Format (stick/cone/diffuser/candle), 5) Budget. Rule-based matching to products. Display personalized result + 'Add to Cart' CTA.

topPriorities.name: Subscription & Discovery Box
topPriorities.why: Incense is consumable — customers repurchase every 2-4 weeks. No competitor offers subscriptions. Recurring revenue = predictable inventory + higher LTV.
topPriorities.implementation: Tiers: Discovery (₹499/mo — 4 surprise fragrances), Essentials (₹299/mo — your 2 favorites), Premium (₹799/mo — full ritual kit). 10% off monthly, 15% off quarterly, 20% off bi-annual. Free shipping always.

topPriorities.name: Packaging Designed for Virality
topPriorities.impact: 5-10K earned Instagram posts/year, zero ad cost
topPriorities.why: Every unboxing = free post to 300+ followers. Phool's packaging is plain brown boxes. SEWA can own the unboxing experience.
topPriorities.implementation: Seed-paper outer box (plantable tuls), artisan-written note inside lid ('Hand-rolled by Asha'), magnetic flap closure (premium feel, zero plastic), QR code → video message from artisan, transparent viewing window.

topPriorities.name: Community & Loyalty Program
topPriorities.why: No incense brand has a loyalty program. Community members have 3-5x LTV. Ambassador programs (Mamaearth model) drive 20-35% of new acquisitions.
topPriorities.implementation: Tiered: Bronze (any purchase → birthday surprise), Silver (₹2K/yr → free shipping + 5% cashback), Gold (₹5K/yr → early access + 10% cashback), Platinum (₹10K/yr → quarterly gift + design your own box). Ambassador: 10% lifetime commission. #SEWAFamily Instagram community.
topPriorities.revenueImpact: 2x repeat rate, 25% new customers via referrals

topPriorities.name: Same-Day Delivery via Dark Stores
topPriorities.impact: 30% repeat rate increase, impulse purchases captured
topPriorities.why: Incense is an impulse category. 3-day delivery kills impulse. Same-day in top-6 cities = game-changer. Phool ships from Kanpur (3-7 days).
topPriorities.implementation: Partner with Shadowfax/Dunzo dark stores in Mumbai, Delhi, Bangalore, Pune, Hyderabad, Chennai. Stock top-10 SKUs in each. Kirana premium store QR code partnerships for 2-hour delivery. Add Blinkit/Zepto 10-min delivery for top SKUs.

whatsappCommerce.headline: WhatsApp Commerce — 90% open rate, 3x email conversion
tactics: WhatsApp Business API catalog with all 8 products + checkout via UPI
Abandoned cart recovery: DM at 1h, 24h, 72h — 25-35% recovery rate
Flash sales: 'Next 30 min — 25% OFF. Reply BUY to order.'
Broadcast weekly to opted-in customers (max 2/week)
Order confirmations + tracking via WhatsApp (preferred over email in India)
Re-order reminder at day 25 post-purchase: 'Running low? Restock now.'
VIP Broadcast list: exclusive products, early access

referralProgram.headline: Double-sided UPI Cashback Referral — India's most viral mechanic
tactics: Give ₹100, Get ₹100 — both referrer and friend get ₹100 UPI cashback (not store credit)
UPI cashback converts 2x better than store credit in India
Referral card inside every package with QR code
WhatsApp share button with pre-filled referral message
Tiered rewards: 5 referrals = early access, 10 = free product, 25 = 'SEWA Ambassador' badge
Post-purchase page: most impactful timing for referral ask

festivalDomination.headline: Own 12 festival boxes/year — ₹50L-1Cr gifting revenue
tactics: 12 festival-specific boxes: Diwali, Holi, Ganesh Chaturthi, Navratri, Rakhi, Eid, Christmas, Pongal, Onam, Durga Puja, Guru Purnima, New Year
Surge pricing: Box price increases as festival approaches (₹999 → ₹1,199 → ₹1,499)
Self-serve corporate gifting portal: upload CSV, customize, schedule delivery
Early-bird pricing 60 days before each festival
Amazon + Blinkit festival category tag applications
Email + WhatsApp festival countdown sequences

influencerArmy.headline: 100 micro-influencers at ₹1,000 avg = ₹1L/mo = 500+ orders
tactics: Micro-influencers (1K-10K followers): 5-10% engagement, ₹500-3,000/post
Performance model: 10% commission + ₹500 bonus if 50+ units sold
Gift 100 micro-influencers product (₹15K cost → 15-20 organic posts)
Focus niches: yoga instructors, clean-living creators, home decor, women empowerment, spiritual/pooja
UTM links + unique discount codes per influencer for tracking
Cut bottom 80% monthly — keep only top 20% performers

reel.idea: Split screen: charcoal incense (heavy smoke) vs SEWA (minimal, clean). Text: '50% more fragrance. Tap to switch.'
No talking. Paper rustle, match strike, gentle blow, smoke swirl. Original audio.
reel.why: ASMR incense has 500M+ YouTube views — no brand owns this space

reel.idea: Close-up hands + face of woman artisan. Her story on text overlay. End: the product she made.
reel.why: Emotional connection = 3x engagement vs product shots

carousel.idea: Hook → 5 toxin slides with SEWA alternative → CTA. Educational = saves = algorithm boost.
carousel.why: Carousels get highest engagement of all formats

carousel.idea: ₹299 / ₹499 / ₹999 / ₹1,999 options. Each slide: product + who it's for.
carousel.why: Gifting content = high shareability during festivals

liveStreaming.idea: Every Saturday 7 PM. Light 3 scents, describe them, answer Q&A. Live-only 10% discount.
liveStreaming.why: IG Live shopping AOV = ₹850-1,200 vs ₹350-500 for shop posts

liveStreaming.idea: Monthly: artisan demonstrates handcrafting, talks about her life. Real-time audience questions.
liveStreaming.why: Authenticity = trust = conversion. Zero brands do this

aiWorkflow.headline: AI-First Content Engine — 80% of content AI-drafted, 20% human-refined
aiWorkflow.existing: 24/7 agent already auto-generates posts, reels, stories, listings, creatives
toBuild: Brand voice training: feed top 10 best-performing posts as examples to model
A/B testing engine: generate 3 caption variants, track engagement, auto-select winner
Performance feedback loop: low-engagement posts auto-regenerate with new angles
Human approval gate: AI drafts → human approves → posts
AI chatbot extension: train on all products + use cases, answer 'Which incense for sleep?'
